purpose: Define the curation engine independently from external research evaluation.

curation_engine.completion_rule: A curation run is complete after Stage C selects and materializes its declared output with an audit trail.
curation_engine.safety_boundary: Stage A applies text normalization and text-integrity handling; optional source, rights, and hazard signals are audit-only in the active profile. Stage B applies chunk-level hard gates; Stage C applies only declared reason-coded text-structural compaction, never a target retention fraction or weighted priority score.

stage_a.language_specific_candidate_boundary: A language-specific parser may create candidate-only validity evidence only for complete sources with a declared compatible language version. It must never infer a language version, source identity, or intrinsic quality, and it cannot remove or select runtime records until its separate promotion gates close.

stage_c_inline_license_header_candidate.operation: remove only a prefix comment header with an explicit license marker when a declared residual payload remains
stage_c_inline_license_header_candidate.post_transform_boundary: retain the transformed chunk only when its residual text still meets the declared payload threshold
stage_c_inline_license_header_candidate.promotion_gate: false-positive fixture, reason-code impact audit, preregistered ablation, and frozen external validation

stage_c_inline_license_comment_block_can.operation: remove only a self-contained contiguous comment block with an explicit license marker when a declared residual payload remains
stage_c_inline_license_comment_block_can.post_transform_boundary: retain the transformed chunk only when its residual text still meets the declared Stage-B minimum_chunk_chars
stage_c_inline_license_comment_block_can.promotion_gate: false-positive fixture, reason-code impact audit, preregistered ablation, and frozen external validation

stage_c_repeated_span_template_candidate.operation: remove a planned exact repeated paragraph only from a nonrepresentative Stage-B chunk when residual payload remains above the declared threshold
stage_c_repeated_span_template_candidate.post_transform_boundary: retain the transformed chunk only when its residual text still meets the declared payload threshold
stage_c_repeated_span_template_candidate.promotion_gate: false-positive fixture, reason-code impact audit, preregistered ablation, and frozen external validation

execution_order: join separately frozen proxy evidence by chunk_uid
stage_c2_model_relative_representative_c.operation: remove only a nonrepresentative semantic-family member when frozen evidence jointly establishes high familiarity, low novelty, and low gradient alignment
stage_c2_model_relative_representative_c.promotion_gate: false-positive fixture, reason-code impact audit, code-math-general development matrix, preregistered ablation, and frozen confirmatory validation

quality_decision_semantics.keep: reserved for a separately validated positive retention policy
quality_decision_semantics.reject: active named policy has explicit non-payload evidence
quality_decision_semantics.abstain_retain: no active rejection policy has sufficient evidence; retain without claiming intrinsic quality

stage_c.quality_reject_fail_closed_rule: If any required deletion-authority field is absent, empty, invalid, or unversioned, the decision is unrepresentable and cannot remove the chunk.

core_behavior_audit.pass_rule: Every Core has positive and negative executable cases, no false positive or false negative, no behavior-invariant failure, and Registry-to-Case-Matrix ownership is reconciled.
core_behavior_audit.claim_boundary: Passing establishes the declared behavior on constructed fixtures only; it is not corpus-wide precision, recall, intrinsic Quality validity, or downstream effectiveness.

external_evaluation.purpose: Measure a frozen curation output for research or release governance.
external_evaluation.runtime_requirement: not required for every curation batch

optional_audit_sidecar.purpose: Traceability, safety review, and distribution reporting when metadata is supplied.

allowed: The framework can produce an auditable full curated pool.
The active framework applies reason-coded Stage-C duplicate and scaffold compaction without an implicit budget and materializes the survivor pool.
not_allowed: The framework measures intrinsic data quality.
A fixed fraction is a general curation policy.
A weighted operational threshold proves universal downstream improvement before external validation.
An unimplemented budget allocator may alter the active curated output.
External evaluation outcomes can tune Stage C within the same frozen cycle.
